verticalTabs.config.alwaysFollowActiveTa: Always follow the active tab. When enabled, switching the focused editor automatically expands its group and scrolls the tab into view. Disable this to preserve the current list position while browsing tabs manually.
verticalTabs.config.position: Position of the vertical tab bar inside the editor area. Changes are applied immediately.
verticalTabs.config.position.left: Place the vertical tab bar at the left edge of the editor area.
verticalTabs.config.position.right: Place the vertical tab bar at the right edge of the editor area.
verticalTabs.config.rememberState: When enabled, remembers group mode, sort mode, manual groups, pinned groups, and adjusted width per workspace. When disabled, always uses the default values.
verticalTabs.config.tabWidthRatio: Width percentage of the vertical tab bar relative to the editor area. Controls the tab bar width on first display or when automatic memory is disabled. Default 20%.
verticalTabs.config.relativePathDisplay: Controls which directory or repository-relative path detail is shown below each tab name.
Show directory name only for files with the same name
Show repository-relative path only for files with the same name
Do not show a second-line path detail.
Show the immediate parent directory only when multiple open files have the same name.
Show the repository-relative path only when multiple open files have the same name.
Always show the immediate parent directory for resource-backed file tabs.
Always show the repository-relative path for files inside the workspace.
verticalTabs.config.defaultGroupMode: Default grouping mode. Always used when automatic memory is disabled; used only when no saved value exists when automatic memory is enabled.
verticalTabs.config.defaultSortMode: Default sort mode. Defaults to manual sort. Always used when automatic memory is disabled; used only when no saved value exists when automatic memory is enabled.
verticalTabs.config.defaultSortMode.none: Manual sort; tabs can be reordered by dragging.
verticalTabs.config.defaultSortMode.mru: Sort by the most recent successful tab activation. Foreground new tabs are included immediately; background or restored tabs not yet activated follow recorded tabs in native order.
verticalTabs.config.defaultSortMode.name: Sort by name ascending.
Sort by name descending.
verticalTabs.config.language: Display language for the vertical tab bar UI. auto follows VS Code display language.
verticalTabs.command.previousInGroup: Vertical Tabs: Switch to Previous Tab in Current Vertical Group
verticalTabs.command.nextInGroup: Vertical Tabs: Switch to Next Tab in Current Vertical Group
verticalTabs.command.previousAcrossGroup: Vertical Tabs: Switch to Previous Tab Across Vertical Groups
verticalTabs.command.nextAcrossGroups: Vertical Tabs: Switch to Next Tab Across Vertical Groups
verticalTabs.command.moveUpInGroup: Vertical Tabs: Move Tab Up in Current Vertical Group
verticalTabs.command.moveDownInGroup: Vertical Tabs: Move Tab Down in Current Vertical Group
verticalTabs.command.moveToPreviousGroup: Vertical Tabs: Move Tab to Previous Vertical Group
verticalTabs.command.moveToNextGroup: Vertical Tabs: Move Tab to Next Vertical Group
verticalTabs.config.defaultToolbarContro: Default visibility for the grouping and sorting dropdown controls. When automatic memory is enabled, this is used only when no saved visibility exists; when automatic memory is disabled, this default is always used.
verticalTabs.config.toolbarPosition: Position of the search and group action icons, grouping and sorting controls, and search box in the vertical tab bar. Changes apply immediately.
verticalTabs.config.toolbarPosition.top: Fix the controls above the tab list.
verticalTabs.config.toolbarPosition.bott: Fix the controls below the tab list and reverse their vertical section order.
